newsitem.title: UK: Unigate, Dairy Crest back in talks - paper.
newsitem.headline: Unigate, Dairy Crest back in talks - paper.

text.p: British dairy and foods company Unigate Plc has reopened talks with rival Dairy Crest over the sale of its cheese businesses, The Times reported in its Tuesday edition.

The newspaper said that according to sources, Unigate -- which has long been trying to reduce its dependence on dairy products -- had agreed to return to the negotiating table after Dairy Crest said it might pay a higher price.

"Although neither company has confirmed it was ever in talks, it is widely understood in the City that they broke off earlier negotiations after Dairy Crest refused to pay more than 10 million pounds...," the Times said.
The companies were not immediately available for comment.
Unigate earlier beat expectations by raising annual profits before tax and exceptional to 129.6 million pounds -- a 3.4 percent rise compared to last year.
